title: pcNN-SN: a physics-enhanced predictor-corrector neural network algorithm coupled with the discrete ordinates method for neutron transport equations
abstract: arXiv:2610.20619v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Super-resolution machine learning methods hold promise for addressing the high computational costs associated with high-dimensional features in traditional transport simulations. This paper proposes a physics-enhanced neural network coupling algorithm for discrete ordinates (SN) transport calculations. Based on high- and low-accuracy data, we develop a predictor-corrector neural network (pcNN) to predict correction factors for coarse-grid solutions. Based on transport equations, local physical features containing subgrid-scale information are selected as network inputs. Dimensionless transformation of physical quantities reduces the input space dimensionality and narrows parameter distributions, facilitating network training. translated_title: pcNN-SN：一种物理增强的预测-校正神经网络算法与离散纵标法耦合求解中子输运方程
translated_abstract: 超分辨率机器学习方法有望解决传统输运模拟中高维特征带来的高计算成本问题。本文提出了一种用于离散纵标（SN）输运计算的物理增强神经网络耦合算法。基于高精度和低精度数据，我们开发了预测-校正神经网络，用于预测粗网格解的校正因子。基于输运方程，选取包含亚网格尺度信息的局部物理特征作为网络输入。通过对物理量进行无量纲变换，降低了输入空间的维度并收窄了参数分布，从而便于网络训练。物理约束被纳入网络模型中，校正后的解保留了其原有的守恒特性。pcNN与SN输运扫掠内部耦合，数值结果表明...
tldr: 本文提出一种物理增强的预测-校正神经网络算法pcNN-SN，通过与离散纵标法耦合，利用高精度数据预测粗网格解的校正因子，在保持守恒性质的同时有效降低中子输运计算的成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes pcNN-SN, a physics-enhanced predictor-corrector neural network algorithm coupled with the discrete ordinates method, which predicts correction factors for coarse-grid solutions to reduce computational costs in neutron transport calculations while preserving conservation properties.
